title: GitHub Star Teardown
description: Critique a repo like a visitor deciding whether to star it in 30 seconds.
prompt: Act like a brutally honest GitHub visitor with 30 seconds. Review the selected README, docs, or project notes. Score: name, above-the-fold clarity, demo proof, install friction, uniqueness, trust, and contribution path. Then give the 10 highest-impact changes, ordered by expected star impact.
